props: Sodium-independent sulfate anion transporter. Can transport other anions including bicarbonate, thiosulfate and oxalate by mediating sulfate-thiosulfate, sulfate-hydrogencarbonate and sulfate-oxalate anion exchange.

nodes.label: SLC26A2
props: Diastrophic dysplasia protein; Solute carrier family 26 member 2

Sulfate transporter which mediates sulfate uptake into chondrocytes in order to maintain adequate sulfation of proteoglycans which is needed for cartilage development. Mediates electroneutral anion exchange of sulfate ions for oxalate ions and of sulfate and oxalate ions for chloride ions.
